item.subject: science
item.stem:
Which of the following statements about health is correct ( )
A. Ravi is healthy because no disease has been found in his body
B. Meena is free from illness but feels lonely and cannot sleep well, so she is fully healthy
C. A person is healthy only when physical, mental, and social well-being are all present, not merely when disease is absent
D. Arjun has strong muscles and plays cricket daily, so he must be healthy even if he is often worried and has no friends

options.A: Ravi is healthy because no disease has been found in his body
options.B: Meena is free from illness but feels lonely and cannot sleep well, so she is fully healthy
options.C: A person is healthy only when physical, mental, and social well-being are all present, not merely when disease is absent
options.D: Arjun has strong muscles and plays cricket daily, so he must be healthy even if he is often worried and has no friends
